# garage_admin_tokens (Data Source)

List all Garage admin tokens.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "garage_admin_tokens" "all" {}

output "token_names" {
  value = data.garage_admin_tokens.all.tokens[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `tokens` (Attributes List) List of admin tokens. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tokens))

<a id="nestedatt--tokens"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tokens`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `expiration` (String) Expiration date.
- `expired` (Boolean) Whether expired.
- `id` (String) Token ID.
- `name` (String) Token name.
- `scope` (List of String) Token scope.
